lines.en: label chinamibrx:
: I would...sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 我……当然希望如此。

lines.en: scene controversialscene2
with fade
: Papa!
lines.zh: : 爸爸！

lines.en: scene controversialscene1
with fade
: Nope.
lines.zh: : 不了。

lines.en: : What? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么了？

lines.en: : What do you mean what’s wrong? You said it was safe to come in.
lines.zh: : 什么叫怎么了？你不是说进来没事吗。

lines.en: : Hm? Cause of Chinami? She’s just a kid, it’s no big deal.
lines.zh: : 嗯？因为 Chinami？她还是个孩子，没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m giving Yumi a bath in here.
lines.zh: : 我又不是在这儿给 Yumi 洗澡。

lines.en: : That’s exactly {i}why{/i} it’s a problem. I would have stayed inside without a question if Yumi was in there.
lines.zh: : 这{i}正是{/i}问题所在。要是 Yumi 在里面，我肯定毫不犹豫地待着。

lines.en: : Hey. Watch it.
lines.zh: : 喂。你说话注意点。

lines.en: : Why won’t Papa come inside? Is he afraid of the bath?
lines.zh: : 爸爸为什么不进来？他是怕浴缸吗？

lines.en: : I guess he just hates you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我猜他就是讨厌你，Chinami。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不是——

lines.en: : Papa, why?!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，为什么？！

lines.en: Am I really the weird one for thinking the right thing to do is wait out here?
lines.zh: 我觉得在外面等着才是对的，难道我真是那个怪人？

lines.en: I get that Chika’s comfortable enough with me that she doesn’t feel threatened about me being around...that.
lines.zh: 我知道 Chika 跟我够亲近，不介意我在……那个……旁边。

lines.en: But why would I even go in there if I can just talk to them through the gap in the door?
lines.zh: 可我既然能隔着门缝跟她们说话，干嘛非进去不可？

lines.en: : Stop being so sketchy and come in already. I’ve just gotta get the soap out of her hair.
lines.zh: : 别鬼鬼祟祟的，快进来。我只需要把她头发里的泡沫冲掉。

lines.en: : Chinami misses you! And you should want to spend time with her because no one knows how much time she has left!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想你！而且你应该多陪陪她，因为谁也不知道她还能活多久！

lines.en: play sound "water1.mp3"
: Chinami! Stop saying that! I mean it!
lines.zh: : Chinami！别再说那个了！我说真的！

lines.en: : Yes, big Sister...
lines.zh: : 好的，姐姐……

lines.en: : Do it again and I’m taking your phone away. That’s not funny.
lines.zh: : 再说一次我就没收你手机。那一点都不好笑。

lines.en: What...should I do here?
lines.zh: 我……该怎么办？

lines.en: menu:
"Wait outside":
lines.zh: "在外面等":

lines.en: : If you’re almost done, I’ll just wait out here.
lines.zh: : 你们要是快洗完了，我就在外面等。

lines.en: : There’s really no need for me to be in there right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我现在也没必要非在里面。

lines.en: : Not sure why you’re being so weird about this, but okay. Do whatever makes you comfortable, I guess.
lines.zh: : 搞不懂你干嘛这么别扭，不过行吧。你觉得怎么舒服就怎么来。

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve2
I avert my gaze as I make my way into the combined living room and bedroom, collapsing onto the same worn down mattress these sisters so often fall asleep on together.
lines.zh: 我移开视线，走进那间客厅兼卧室，瘫倒在这对姐妹常一起睡的那张破旧床垫上。

lines.en: And as I wait for the two of them to finish in the bathroom, I’m stricken by the unhealthy thought that I now want to buy them a new bed in addition to their phones.
lines.zh: 一边等她们俩洗完澡，我一边冒出一个不健康的念头：除了手机，我现在还想给她们买张新床。

lines.en: Maybe this is just one more way I can trick myself into thinking I’m somehow a positive influence on their lives...but maybe it’s more than that?
lines.zh: 也许这只是我骗自己「我对她们的人生多少是个正面影响」的又一种方式……但也许不止如此？

lines.en: Maybe I {i}do{/i} actually want to help them? Or...give them better lives or something.
lines.zh: 也许我{i}是{/i}真想帮她们？或者……让她们过上好日子之类的。

lines.en: Or maybe that’s just me imagining a single trace of light in a world I believe to be devoid of it.
lines.zh: 又或者，那只是我在一个我认为毫无光亮的世界里，凭空想象出的一丝光。

lines.en: You can’t give someone a better life by just handing them things they’d have trouble obtaining on their own.
lines.zh: 你不能光靠把别人自己难得的东西塞给他们，就让人过上好日子。

lines.en: Sure, it would make things a little better for them in the moment, but what comes after that?
lines.zh: 是，那样眼下是能让他们好过点，可那之后呢？

lines.en: Chika’s already starting to depend on me a little too much.
lines.zh: Chika 已经开始有点太依赖我了。

lines.en: But I guess it would be hard {i}not{/i} to depend on me when I’m the first person in a long time that’s actually felt depend{i}able{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过也难怪——我是这么久以来第一个让她觉得{i}靠得住{/i}的人。

lines.en: It’s sad.
lines.zh: 挺可悲的。

lines.en: I thought she was smarter than this.
lines.zh: 我原以为她比这聪明。

lines.en: jump restofchinamibr
"Go in. This is normal.":
lines.zh: "进去吧。这很正常。":

lines.en: Chika’s right.
lines.zh: Chika 说得对。

lines.en: This would only be a big deal if I turned it into one.
lines.zh: 这事只有我把它当回事，才算回事。

lines.en: And treating Chinami like she’s a normal girl instead of what she really is would be the number one way to do that.
lines.zh: 而把 Chinami 当成普通女孩、而不是她「真正的身份」来对待，正是把它当回事的头号做法。

lines.en: In fact, Chika would probably be more suspicious {i}if{/i} I stayed outside.
lines.zh: 其实，我{i}要是{/i}待在外面，Chika 反而会更起疑。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: This is normal.
lines.zh: 这很正常。

lines.en: {i}I{/i} am normal.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}很正常。

lines.en: scene controversialscene3
with dissolve2
$ sawchinami = True
: Hooray! Papa doesn’t hate Chinami after all!
lines.zh: : 万岁！爸爸原来不讨厌 Chinami！

lines.en: : You good?
lines.zh: : 你还好吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I just thought Chinami would feel uncomfortable having a boy in here. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只是觉得 Chinami 会不习惯屋里有个男生。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know why that would change anything. She likes Papa and wants him to {i}always{/i} be around.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不懂那有什么关系。她喜欢爸爸，想让他{i}一直{/i}在身边。

lines.en: : And {i}Chika{/i} didn’t realize this was going to be a point of contention.
lines.zh: : 而且 {i}Chika{/i} 也没想到这居然会成个问题。

lines.en: : Well, {i}Sensei{/i} thinks it’s time to talk about something else before this gets even weirder.
lines.zh: : 行吧，{i}Sensei{/i} 觉得在事情变得更怪之前，该聊点别的了。

lines.en: : Chinami is pleased with how everyone is speaking now. She feels like she is starting a trend.
lines.zh: : Chinami 对大家现在的说话方式很满意。她觉得自己带动了一股潮流。

lines.en: scene controversialscene4
with dissolve
: {i}Chinami{/i} should learn to wash her own hair instead of making her big sister do it all the time.
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami{/i} 该学着自己洗头，别老让姐姐洗。

lines.en: : And she should also take off her ribbon when she’s in the bath.
lines.zh: : 而且洗澡的时候也该把发带摘了。

lines.en: : But if Chinami takes off her ribbon, Chinami will deflate! It is what keeps all of the air inside of her! And where she stores her magic!
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 要是摘了发带，Chinami 会漏气的！那是把气全锁在里面的东西！也是她存魔法的地方！

lines.en: Just like I thought.
lines.zh: 果然跟我想的一样。

lines.en: This is all completely normal.
lines.zh: 这一切完全正常。

lines.en: scene controversialscene5
with dissolve
: Papa, help! Chinami wants you to wash her hair instead! Big sis Chika is being too rough!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，救命！Chinami 想让你帮她洗头！Chika 姐姐洗得太用力了！

lines.en: : I’m good right here, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿挺好，谢了。

lines.en: scene controversialscene6
with dissolve
: Want me to wash {i}your{/i} hair next, Sensei? Tub’s already full. Might as well get as much out of the water as we can.
lines.zh: : 要不要我接着帮{i}你{/i}洗，Sensei？浴缸水都放满了，不如多利用利用。

lines.en: : Again, I’m good right here. I think that tub might be a little too small for me anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我在这儿挺好。反正那浴缸对我可能也太小了点。

lines.en: scene controversialscene7
with dissolve
: Suit yourself! Don’t come crying to me when you run up your water bill, though.
lines.zh: : 随你！不过等你水费账单爆了，可别来哭着找我。

lines.en: : The water bill is a mostly negligible cost once you aren’t confined to working a minimum wage retail job anymore.
lines.zh: : 一旦你不再被最低工资的零售工作绑死，水费基本可以忽略不计。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Wanna help {i}me{/i} go look for a new one, then? You know, since you’re already helping Yumi and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那要不要帮{i}我{/i}找份新的？反正你已经在帮 Yumi 了嘛。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi will never get a job. She’s too misunderstood.
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐永远找不到工作的。她太不被人理解了。

lines.en: : You’d certainly be easier to find one for.
lines.zh: : 你可比她好找工作多了。

lines.en: : I think you should be fine where you are until you’re out of school, though. If you can’t find a new job after that, {i}then{/i} I’ll help you go hunting.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得你毕业前先干着现在这个就行。之后要是找不到新的，我{i}再{/i}帮你一起找。

lines.en: : Yumi’s just getting {i}all{/i} the special treatment then, huh? Job hunting {i}and{/i} bath company.
lines.zh: : 那 Yumi 就是{i}独享{/i}特殊待遇喽？帮找工作，{i}还{/i}陪洗澡。

lines.en: : Hey, I never would have offered to watch her if you didn’t bring the idea up.
lines.zh: : 喂，要不是你先提出来，我才不会说要看着她。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll be sure to relay it to her the next time she goes to wash her hair.
lines.zh: : 行，下次她去洗头，我一定替你转达。

lines.en: : Please don’t. She hates me enough as is. The last thing I need is her knowing that I’m getting myself involved in conversations like this.
lines.zh: : 千万别。她已经够讨厌我了。我可不想再让她知道我掺和进这种对话。

lines.en: scene controversialscene8
with dissolve
: Chinami thinks big sis Yumi likes you a lot and that she just doesn’t know how to express it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得 Yumi 姐姐其实很喜欢你，只是她不知道怎么表达！

lines.en: : She always says she never had a mom or a dad, so Chinami thinks that she never learned how to be nice.
lines.zh: : 她老说自己没有爸爸妈妈，所以 Chinami 觉得她从没学过怎么待人友善。

lines.en: : If somebody teaches big sis Yumi to be nice, Chinami thinks she’ll start saying less mean things to you.
lines.zh: : 要是有人教 Yumi 姐姐友善一点，Chinami 觉得她就不会老对你说难听的话了。

lines.en: : Why don’t {i}you{/i} teach her to be nice, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}干嘛不教她友善点，Chinami？

lines.en: scene controversialscene9
with dissolve
: Chinami tries! But big sis Yumi has already tried to kill her once!
lines.zh: : Chinami 有试啊！可 Yumi 姐姐已经想杀过她一次了！

lines.en: : Is this about the peanuts?
lines.zh: : 是为了花生那事？

lines.en: : It’s about the peanuts.
lines.zh: : 就是为了花生。

lines.en: : Nowhere is safe for Chinami! This is a dog eat dog world, and Chinami {i}is{/i} a dog sometimes!
lines.zh: : Chinami 到哪儿都不安全！这是个狗咬狗的世界，而 Chinami {i}有{/i}时候也是条狗！

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. How about we just {i}both{/i} try to teach Yumi how to be nice, then?
lines.zh: : 行行行。那要不{i}咱俩{/i}一起教 Yumi 怎么友善点？

lines.en: scene controversialscene10
with dissolve
: Just not {i}too{/i} nice. Because then {i}Papa{/i} might think twice about coming over here to see {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 就是别{i}太{/i}友善。不然{i}爸爸{/i}可能会重新考虑要不要来看{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m here for Chinami. You’re just a bonus.
lines.zh: : 喂，我是来看 Chinami 的。你只是附带的。

lines.en: scene controversialscene11
with dissolve
: Uh-huh. Right. So you just dialed my number by mistake this morning?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吗。那你今早是「不小心」拨错我的号？

lines.en: : Your numbers are right next to each other in my phone. I probably just tapped the wrong one.
lines.zh: : 你俩的号码在我手机里挨着。我大概就是点错了。

lines.en: : Be careful, big sister! It looks like you might really have to worry after all!
lines.zh: : 小心点，姐姐！看来你说不定真得担心一下了！

lines.en: scene controversialscene12
with dissolve
: Hey! Shh! I told you not to talk about that! I wasn’t “worrying” about anything! I was just...thinking!
lines.zh: : 喂！嘘！我不是叫你别提那个吗！我才没「担心」什么！我只是……在想！

lines.en: : Chinami can’t be stopped! And she can’t help if Papa likes her more than her big sister!
lines.zh: : Chinami 停不下来！而且要是爸爸喜欢她胜过姐姐，那也不是她的错！

lines.en: : Worrying?
lines.zh: : 担心？

lines.en: : About what we talked about at the mall?
lines.zh: : 担心我们在商场聊的那件事？

lines.en: scene controversialscene13
with dissolve
: Um...could you give the two of us a minute, Sensei? I’d like to remind my sister about certain things I don’t want her saying around you.
lines.zh: : 那个……你能给我俩一分钟吗，Sensei？我想提醒我妹妹，有些话我不想让她当你面说。

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 拜托了？

lines.en: : Sure. Though, it is a little weird to be kicked out of this room when you practically begged me to come inside.
lines.zh: : 行。不过你刚才几乎是求我进来，现在又把我赶出这屋，是有点怪。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I {i}begged{/i}...
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}求{/i}你……

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve
: I would.
lines.zh: : 我会这么说。

lines.en: Especially since it helps me justify how long I just hung around my fake girlfriend’s naked sister for.
lines.zh: 尤其因为这能帮我合理化：我刚才在我「假女友」的裸体妹妹身边耗了那么久。

lines.en: As I leave the room, though, I realize that I {i}was{/i} just making a big deal over nothing-
lines.zh: 不过走出房间时，我意识到自己刚才{i}是{/i}小题大做了——

lines.en: And that just seeing someone without their clothes on isn’t enough for me to {i}want{/i} them.
lines.zh: 而且，光是看到一个人没穿衣服，并不足以让我{i}想{/i}要她。

lines.en: I’m not used to that.
lines.zh: 我不习惯这样。

lines.en: I’m not used to feeling like I’m in complete control over how I feel because, frankly, most of the time, I’m not.
lines.zh: 我不习惯觉得自己能完全掌控自己的感受，因为坦白说，大多数时候我做不到。

lines.en: I’m glad that today I was, though.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴，今天我做到了。

lines.en: And I hope that, at least for a while longer-
lines.zh: 而且我希望，至少再过一阵子——

lines.en: I will continue to be.
lines.zh: 我能一直做到。

lines.en: I make my way into the combined living room and bedroom, collapsing onto the same worn down mattress the Chosokabe sisters so often fall asleep on together.
lines.zh: 我走进那间客厅兼卧室，瘫倒在长宗我部姐妹常一起睡的那张破旧床垫上。

lines.en: And as I wait for the two of them to finish in the bathroom, I’m stricken by the unhealthy thought that I now want to buy them a new bed in addition to their phones.
lines.zh: 一边等她们俩洗完澡，我一边冒出一个不健康的念头：除了手机，我现在还想给她们买张新床。

lines.en: Maybe this is just one more way I can trick myself into thinking I’m somehow a positive influence on their lives...but maybe it’s more than that?
lines.zh: 也许这只是我骗自己「我对她们的人生多少是个正面影响」的又一种方式……但也许不止如此？

lines.en: Maybe I {i}do{/i} actually want to help them? Or...give them better lives or something.
lines.zh: 也许我{i}是{/i}真想帮她们？或者……让她们过上好日子之类的。

lines.en: Or maybe that’s just me imagining a single trace of light in a world I believe to be devoid of it.
lines.zh: 又或者，那只是我在一个我认为毫无光亮的世界里，凭空想象出的一丝光。

lines.en: You can’t give someone a better life by just handing them things they’d have trouble obtaining on their own.
lines.zh: 你不能光靠把别人自己难得的东西塞给他们，就让人过上好日子。

lines.en: Sure, it would make things a little better for them in the moment, but what comes after that?
lines.zh: 是，那样眼下是能让他们好过点，可那之后呢？

lines.en: Chika’s already starting to depend on me a little too much.
lines.zh: Chika 已经开始有点太依赖我了。

lines.en: But I guess it would be hard {i}not{/i} to be when I’m the first person in a long time that’s actually felt depend{i}able{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过也难怪——我是这么久以来第一个让她觉得{i}靠得住{/i}的人。

lines.en: It’s sad.
lines.zh: 挺可悲的。

lines.en: I always thought she was smarter than this.
lines.zh: 我一直以为她比这聪明。
